title: Site styles
rows: Font for headings: Source Sans Pro (the site's font), Roboto or Roboto Condensed; or the name of a font uploaded to AEM Assets, with its files below. Example: change this to Merriweather to use the Merriweather files below. Empty: the site's font.

Only for a font from AEM Assets: path of its regular .woff2 file (used when heading-font is that font's name, e.g. Merriweather). The file must be published; if it isn't, headings stay in the site's font.
Only for a font from AEM Assets: path of its bold .woff2 file. Merriweather is one file for all weights, so it's the same path.
Font for body text: Source Sans Pro (the site's font) or Roboto; or the name of a font uploaded to AEM Assets, with body-font-file below. Empty: the site's font.
Only for a font from AEM Assets: path of its regular .woff2 file.
Only for a font from AEM Assets: path of its bold .woff2 file.
